customSections.label: What WCSD Families Should Know
customSections.content: Three details on the Balanced Calendar need more context than a date list alone provides.

groups.label: Contingency days
items: June 2–4 are regular scheduled school days, and June 4 remains the last day of school. WCSD's August 7 update confirms that cancellation days will not be added after June 4.

groups.label: Professional-development days
items: Students do not attend October 12, November 3, or January 4. WCSD counts these professional-development dates as school days in session under the note printed on the official calendar.

groups.label: Conference week
items: WCSD marks October 23 and October 26–29 as conference dates, but the calendar does not designate the entire period as a districtwide student holiday. Check the school for appointment and dismissal details.

whatsNew.title: What Changed from 2025–26
content: Pre-K and kindergarten students on the Balanced Calendar now start August 10 with other students. The separate kindergarten testing week and later kindergarten start used in 2025–26 are gone.
The 2026–27 calendar adds November 3 as a no-student professional-development day, along with October 12 and January 4.
Spring Break moves one week later, running March 22–April 2 instead of March 16–27.
The final contingency dates are explicitly in session June 2–4, and June 4 is the scheduled last day.

sourceReviewSummary: Reviewed August 11, 2026, against WCSD's Balanced Calendar dated May 1, 2026, and the district's August 7 calendar update.
sourceReviewDetails: The Balanced Calendar lists August 10, 2026, as the first day and June 4, 2027, as the last day.
WCSD's August 7 update confirms that June 4 remains the last day and that cancellation days will not be added at the end of the school year.
The district publishes separate English and Spanish calendars for the Balanced, Gerlach, Incline, and TMCC schedules.
The 2025–26 Balanced Calendar was reviewed for the year-over-year comparison.

calendarFaqs.q: Which WCSD calendar should my student use?
calendarFaqs.a: Most WCSD schools use the Balanced Calendar shown on this page. Students assigned to Gerlach, Incline, or TMCC should use that school's separate official calendar.

calendarFaqs.q: When does WCSD start school in 2026–27?
calendarFaqs.a: Students on the Balanced Calendar start Monday, August 10, 2026. Incline starts August 17, while Gerlach and TMCC publish separate schedules.

calendarFaqs.q: When is WCSD Fall Break in 2026?
calendarFaqs.a: Fall Break on the Balanced Calendar runs October 5–9, 2026.

calendarFaqs.q: When is WCSD Winter Break in 2026–27?
calendarFaqs.a: Winter Break on the Balanced Calendar runs December 21, 2026, through January 1, 2027. January 4 is a no-student professional-development day, and classes resume January 5.

calendarFaqs.q: When is WCSD Spring Break in 2027?
calendarFaqs.a: Spring Break on the Balanced Calendar runs March 22 through April 2, 2027.

calendarFaqs.q: When is the WCSD last day in 2026–27?
calendarFaqs.a: The Balanced Calendar ends Friday, June 4, 2027. June 2–4 are labeled contingency days in session, not optional vacation days.

calendarFaqs.q: Do students attend school on WCSD's June 2–4 contingency days?
calendarFaqs.a: Yes. June 2, 3, and 4 are scheduled school days on the 2026–27 Balanced Calendar. June 4 is the last day of school.
